normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Newly remodeled in 2025- Short walk to the beach, community pools, and amenities- Steps from the famous Seaside Town Square featuring plenty of shopping and dining- Lookout tower- Game room- Close to Family Pool- 2 Large decks - Cut through area to Watercolor- Parking for 2 vehicles - 5 adult bikes- Propane grill- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Experience convenience and serenity at Ocean Eyes, a remodeled beach residence boasting 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and 2 half baths that comfortably accommodate up to 12 guests. As the world’s first New Urbanist town, Seaside was designed for walkability—within minutes, enjoy a community pool, fitness center, tennis courts, playground shopping, dining, various beach accesses, and a special cut-through to WaterColor. After a day of sun and beachside fun, guests will love relaxing on the 2 spacious decks or lookout tower while enjoying the peaceful views and people-watching.Nestled on the tranquil Forest Street, this 2-level home welcomes guests with a shaded front porch adorned with a bench swing, chairs, and dining space for 4. Step inside to find hardwood floors, pastel finishes, and slip-covered furniture, creating a cozy atmosphere. The living room features a 65” Smart TV, while the oval dining table for 6 leads to a cheerful kitchen with pale cabinets and whimsical, colorful tile work. When evening falls, retire to the 2 guest bedrooms on this level—all the home’s bedrooms feature a private bathroom. The first guest bedroom has 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, and the second guest bedroom has a queen bed, a 50” Smart TV, and backyard access.Ascend to the second floor to relax in the game room with a twin-over-twin bunk bed—perfect for children, teens, or guests who don’t mind sharing space. The beautiful primary bedroom offers a tranquil retreat with a king bed and a charming balcony. A guest bedroom with a king bed finishes the floor. Both bedrooms and the game room are equipped with 32" TVs.Take the stairs to the lookout tower to enjoy 360-degree views of the neighborhood.Proximity to community pools, beach accesses, and award-winning shopping and dining experiences make Ocean Eyes an ideal base for a delightful Seaside vacation. While the community is walkable, guests can take advantage of 2 on-site parking spaces—plus the 5 included adult bikes for effortless exploration. The nearest beach access is at the end of Odessa Street. Book this beach escape today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Common Area: Half BathSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Game Room: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed - Half bathroomUnfortunately, the HOA in this community prohibits Low-Speed Vehicle rentals or for guests to bring their own.***Unfortunately, we can not allow animals in this home unless the animal is a certified service animal. Failure to adhere to this rule will result in immediate eviction and loss of deposit. Guest is fully responsible for all damages.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seaside "Ocean Eyes" 824 Forest Street Santa Rosa Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-080062 Bedrooms 4 Beds 9 Sleeps 12 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 2 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Newly remodeled in 2025 - Short walk to the beach, community pools, and amenities - Steps from the famous Seaside Town Square featuring plenty of shopping and dining - Lookout tower - Game room - Close to Family Pool - 2 Large decks - Cut through area to Watercolor - Parking for 2 vehicles - 5 adult bikes - Propane grill - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Experience convenience and serenity at Ocean Eyes, a remodeled beach residence boasting 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and 2 half baths that comfortably accommodate up to 12 guests. As the world’s first New Urbanist town, Seaside was designed for walkability—within minutes, enjoy a community pool, fitness center, tennis courts, playground shopping, dining, various beach accesses, and a special cut-through to WaterColor. After a day of sun and beachside fun, guests will love relaxing on the 2 spacious decks or lookout tower while enjoying the peaceful views and people-watching. Nestled on the tranquil Forest Street, this 2-level home welcomes guests with a shaded front porch adorned with a bench swing, chairs, and dining space for 4. Step inside to find hardwood floors, pastel finishes, and slip-covered furniture, creating a cozy atmosphere. The living room features a 65” Smart TV, while the oval dining table for 6 leads to a cheerful kitchen with pale cabinets and whimsical, colorful tile work. When evening falls, retire to the 2 guest bedrooms on this level—all the home’s bedrooms feature a private bathroom. The first guest bedroom has 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, and the second guest bedroom has a queen bed, a 50” Smart TV, and backyard access. Ascend to the second floor to relax in the game room with a twin-over-twin bunk bed—perfect for children, teens, or guests who don’t mind sharing space. The beautiful primary bedroom offers a tranquil retreat with a king bed and a charming balcony. A guest bedroom with a king bed finishes the floor. Both bedrooms and the game room are equipped with 32" TVs. Take the stairs to the lookout tower to enjoy 360-degree views of the neighborhood. Proximity to community pools, beach accesses, and award-winning shopping and dining experiences make Ocean Eyes an ideal base for a delightful Seaside vacation. While the community is walkable, guests can take advantage of 2 on-site parking spaces—plus the 5 included adult bikes for effortless exploration. The nearest beach access is at the end of Odessa Street. Book this beach escape today!
